description: On-brand visual work: capture a brand once, then build real PowerPoint decks in that brand, with logo, colours and fonts applied.

prerequisites: Your logo as a PNG file, and your brand colours if you know them
first-value.starter-task: Capture your brand once, then build a deck in it
first-value.starter-prompt: Set up our brand kit from this logo (./brand/logo.png) and these colours: #0E5A46, #F2A541. Then turn ./notes/q3-update.md into a five-slide deck in that brand for Thursday's team meeting.
first-value.verification: brand-kit writes brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md with contrast checked, and deck-builder writes an editable .pptx in your colours and fonts with your logo, using only the content you gave it.
first-value.recovery: If the deck comes out in default colours, check that deck-builder was given the brand.json path. If brand-kit does not activate, ask for it by name ("use brand-kit").

journey.when: You need a deck in your own branding and do not want to answer the brand questions every time.
you_bring: your logo as a PNG, and a white version if you have one
brand colours, fonts or a PowerPoint template, if you know them
the content: the doc or points for the deck
the audience and how long you have to present

steps.you_do: Hand over your logo, colours and any brand guidelines or template.
steps.you_get: A brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md, with text contrast checked and each value traced to where it came from.

steps.you_do: Give it the content, the audience and the time slot.
steps.you_get: A slide-by-slide outline with takeaway titles, key points, speaker notes, backup slides for likely questions, and a slide-count check against the time.

steps.you_do: Hand it the outline, the audience and your brand.json.
steps.you_get: An editable .pptx in your brand, with charts, tables and images where the content calls for them.

steps.you_do: Run it on the deck against the deck rubric, as deck-builder recommends.
steps.you_get: A verdict and severity-tagged findings with a fix for each.
steps.decide: Ship the deck, apply the changes, or rework the outline.

journey.you_end_with: A reusable brand kit and a reviewed, on-brand .pptx.
